newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Community Bank purchase proposal approved.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Community Bank purchase proposal approved.

text.p: The South African Reserve Bank and Ministry of Finance had approved Unibank Ltd's proposed acquisition of shareholders' interests in Community Bank, curator Stewart Patterson said on Thursday.
He said that the price would be determined once a due diligence exercise had been satisfactorily carried out.

The price was also subject to the curator having settled all claims of creditors of Community Bank, retrenched necessary staff, closed branches that were not required by Unibank and settled all contractual commitments.

Patterson said the services of branch staff who were originally due to be retrenched on October 31 would now be extended to November 30 in order to give Unibank time to consider which branches it may wish to retain.
The cash-strapped mutually-owned institution was placed under curatorship in May after unsuccessful attempts to secure funders.
